claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says many off-world civilizations use some form of money for transactions and cooperation.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She draws on Federation and Taygetan archives; these are not necessarily Earth-style economies.

claims.assertion: In her account, advanced off-world societies use money only when needed; internally they share abundant resources without an economy.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Remaining exchanges are friendly barter with little value compensation.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says off-world societies often value original, rare artworks as exchange goods, while replicable gold may serve industrial uses.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Originals outrank copies; replicated gold is used industrially.
